text: Amara flies to Lagos sometime next week for her cousin's wedding. Eleven hour flight with two kids, she's dreading it.

housewarming at Damian and Laila's sat from 7. bring a bottle, they've got the new cat Biscuit so no lilies. Laila says the place still needs loads doing, kitchen's gutted, they're living off a microwave till end of the month. Damian's mum is coming down from Leeds to help paint. Might offer to lend them the ladder and the dust sheets.
Neha has her second interview at the bank Thursday at 2pm. Really nervous about the presentation part. Text her good luck that morning.

Okay so just got off the phone with Eamon. He's been offered the job in Toronto, starts early March, and they're putting the flat on the market end of the month. His wife Natasha isn't sure about it yet, she's worried about leaving her mum who's not been well. Kids are excited though. I should call him next weekend to see how the sale's going.
Chidi's 40th dinner cancelled, his dad's in hospital again.
Remind me to send Bruno the link to that recruiter
noor back from japan tues night. ask how the ryokan was
Irina Petrov — Rina to everyone — applying for the head of ops role at her place. Deadline Friday at 5.
Booked my flights to Lisbon for the 14th, early flight at 6.40 so taxi at half 4.
Milan didn't get the job at Arup. Gutted. Said he'll keep applying over the summer. Must check in with him in a couple of weeks.
Dinner at Suzanne's on the 12th at half 7. She's vegan now, so dessert I'm bringing has to be too.
Eli loves Formula 1, has been to Monza twice. Wants to do Suzuka one day. good gift idea maybe, the F1 book?

Kalani and her partner Joe are going to Iceland end of November for their anniversary. Northern lights trip. She asked if I've got a decent camera to lend. I said yes. Need to charge the batteries and find the tripod before they go, and show her how the manual settings work — maybe one evening next week after work, Tuesday or Wednesday.
Hoang's leaving drinks tomorrow at 6, The Crown. Need to sign the card before lunch.

So, voice note. Alessia called. Her brother Carlos finally got the visa sorted so he's flying out to Melbourne sometime in the first week of December. She's throwing him a send off at hers, probably the Saturday before, and wants me to help with food. Also she mentioned she's got an interview herself on Monday morning for the marketing manager job at Spotify, and she's quite anxious about it. Don't forget to message her Sunday night.
Björn's mum turns 70 next month, big party in Malmö. He's going for the whole week.
Interview prep: read up on the company, STAR answers, iron the blue shirt. Wednesday 10am.
Ebony said her dog Pickle has to have an operation on his leg on Friday morning. She's taking the day off.
Got invited to Miriam's 50th, Saturday the 28th, garden party from 3. dress code smart casual
Dafydd hates flying. White knuckles the whole way, even short hops. Taking the ferry to Dublin instead in the spring.
Salma started at the new agency on Monday. Says the team's lovely but the commute's brutal. Ask her how week one went.
Anjali Kaur. Works at the council in planning. Sister of Neha. Met her at the barbecue.
Just heard from Kaito, his visa interview at the embassy was moved to the 3rd at 9am. He's stressed, everything rides on it. I said I'd drive him there. Pick him up at 8.

Eva and Oliver's engagement party end of the month, haven't got a date yet. Eva wants it at the boathouse, Oliver wants something smaller at his parents' place in Kent. They've been arguing about it for weeks apparently. His sister Alessia is on Eva's side. I've been asked to do a playlist either way, so start on that sometime this week.
note to self — renew passport before Easter
Nikolai's back from six weeks in Patagonia. Lost loads of weight, looks great. Has about a thousand photos he wants to show us over dinner sometime next week.
Abebe has a panel interview at the hospital tomorrow afternoon, for the senior nurse post. Call him Thursday evening to find out how it went.
Chatted to Nora on the train. She's moving to Bristol in the new year, new job at the university, research fellow. Her partner stays in London for now.
Amara texted, they landed safely. Kids were angels apparently. Wedding's Saturday.
Don't forget Laila's birthday on the 9th. She's been going on about a Le Creuset dish. The orange one.
Bruno, Damian and me — curry night Friday at 8. I'm booking the table.
Mrs Fischer next door going to her daughter's in Canada for Christmas, back mid January. Asked me to water the plants and take the post in.
hmm. Neha didn't get it. second time this year. she's fine she says but she isn't. I need to take her out for lunch sometime soon.
Carlos's flight is the 4th at 11pm, from Heathrow. Alessia's driving him.
Irina got the job!! Starts in January. Send flowers.
Got the email from Hargreaves — second round next Tuesday at 11. Video call, 45 mins.
Uncle Dafydd's retirement do is on the 20th at the rugby club, 7 till late. Mum wants us there by half 6.

Joe said Kalani's been really low since her nan died last month. The Iceland trip's what's keeping her going. She's also been signed off work for two weeks, which she hates, she's not someone who sits still. Her nan basically raised her. Maybe drop her a message this week, nothing heavy, and ask if she fancies a walk on Sunday morning.
Eamon's farewell party is the 22nd, Saturday afternoon. He said bring the kids. Natasha's doing a big paella.
Milan's girlfriend Ebony is pregnant, due early June! They're both over the moon. Told me at the pub last night.
Suzanne's trip to Kenya is off, her passport didn't come back in time. Going to Cornwall instead over half term.
Oliver applied for three jobs this week alone. Mostly product roles. He's really burnt out at the current place, his manager's a nightmare.

Salma Patel. Recruiter at Hays. Said she'd ring back about the contract role sometime before the end of next week. Six months, fully remote, day rate's decent. Client's a fintech in Manchester, wants someone who's done payments before. Interview would be two stages, first one a technical chat with their lead, a guy called Hoang. Update the CV tonight.

Long chat with Miriam over coffee this morning. Her son Eli's off to Ghana for a gap year in September, volunteering at a school in Kumasi. She's proud but clearly terrified. He flies the 2nd, and she's already planning a little going away dinner the week before. She asked if I'd say a few words. Should start thinking about what to say.
Natasha loves gardening, tomatoes mostly. Hates cooking though.
Weekend away with Noor in Porto booked, Friday 17th to Monday, flight out at 7pm Friday.
chidi's dad out of hospital wednesday morning. call chidi friday
Noor's sister Laila got into the conservatoire, starts in September. Huge deal for the family.
Damian's interview for the teaching job went well he thinks, hear back by Friday. Text him over the weekend.
Supermarket: wine for Suzanne's, oat cream, candles.
Kaito Sato, from the Tokyo office. Over here for three months on secondment. Big jazz fan. Lives in Shoreditch for now.
Anjali's flat warming Saturday week. 8ish. she said don't bring anything but obviously I will
Hoang flies to Hanoi on the 30th for his grandad's funeral. Won't be back till mid December. Really cut up about it.
Abebe got the senior nurse job! Starts on the ward early January. His wife Miriam is throwing him a dinner on Sunday at 1.
Björn's partner Nikolai has his citizenship test on Monday at 10. Nervous wreck apparently. Message him good luck Sunday night and ask how it went Monday evening.

Lunch with Ebony. She's having a rough time — morning sickness all day, every day. Her boss isn't being great about it either. Eva's throwing her a baby shower sometime in April, Ebony doesn't know yet.
Eva Moreau. Interior designer, freelance. Lives in Hackney with Oliver. Allergic to nuts. Met through Kalani.

Thinking I'll do the solo trip to Vietnam over the summer. Three weeks, maybe four. Fly into Hanoi, work down the coast, finish in Saigon. Hoang said his cousin runs a homestay in Hoi An and could sort me out a room. Flights look cheapest if I go early July and come back start of August.
Remind me to thank Damian and Laila for dinner Saturday night, the lamb was incredible. Also ask Laila for the recipe.

Spoke to Carlos briefly. Landed in Melbourne fine, 23 hours door to door, jet lag awful. Starts at the restaurant on Monday the 10th, early shift 6am. He wants Alessia and me to visit sometime next spring, maybe March. Said he'd FaceTime on Christmas morning, his time. Must send him a postcard before then.
